bias_targets.methodology: Applying the AFLITE algorithm to adversarially filter out highly predictable instances that exhibit unintended input-output correlations, and evaluating models on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution datasets to measure generalization and performance drops.

Testing Natural Language Inference (NLI) models on diagnostic and out-of-distribution datasets like HANS (which targets structural heuristics like word overlap), and comparing against partial-input (hypothesis-only) baselines.

Evaluating image classification models trained on filtered ImageNet data using the ImageNet-A adversarial challenge set to test out-of-distribution generalization and reliance on biases like canonical poses or texture.
